title: •. Hovve the father is creatour and preſeruour of all thinges.

segments.text: IT is he that hath created all of nothinge, a when it ſéemed good to him by his eternal worde, that is •o ſaye by his ſonne. And whiche hathe •et, eſtabliſhed and ordained al thinges, as alſo he ſuſtaineth and gouerneth all according to his eternal prouidence, by his infinite and ſubſtaunciall power, and vertue which is the holy ghoſt proceding from the father and the ſonne.
